item.title: Tasktap 1.0.2 — Clearer review and update reminders
item.description:
• Automatic update checks with a quiet badge and confirmation before installation and restart.
  • Flat request review, focused edit controls and a wider compact notch.
  • One Reply action for typing or speech, with intent interpreted by the same agent.
  • A clearer product walkthrough, real embedded-agent screenshots and updated documentation.

Finish capture, setup and review edits before updating. Existing workspaces, notes and preferences are retained. Apple silicon, macOS 26+ and Python 3 for terminal sessions. Community build, not Apple notarized.
